# Download a completion certificate

> **Status:** Draft
> **Agreed:** not yet
> **Roadmap:** Learners help themselves

## Problem

Learners on our compliance-training platform need proof of completion for their employer. They email support for it, about 90 emails a week, and wait a day or two for a reply.

## Outcome

A learner downloads a certificate themselves the moment they finish a course.

**Measure:** Support emails asking for proof of completion fall from about 90 a week to under 10 within six weeks of release.

## Scope

**In:**

- A PDF certificate for each completed course.
- A page where an employer checks a certificate number.

**Out:**

- Printed certificates sent by post.
- Certificates for partly completed courses.
- A different certificate design per employer.

## Acceptance criteria

- **A1.** The certificate should look professional and be suitable for employers.
- **A2.** When a learner finishes the last module of a course, a "Download certificate" button appears on the course page.
- **A3.** Certificate downloads should work well even at busy times.
- **A4.** The certificate shows the learner's full name, the course title, the completion date, and a certificate number.
- **A5.** When an employer enters a certificate number on the "Verify a certificate" page, the page shows the learner's name, the course title, and the completion date.
